newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African turns vigilante after car hijacked.
newsitem.headline: S.African turns vigilante after car hijacked.

text.p: A 58-year-old South African man on Monday turned vigilante when he gave chase, shot and injured two men who had hijacked his neighbour's car as she left her driveway in a suburb east of Johannesburg, residents said.

Johannesburg has been plagued by car hijackings -- the theft of a car with the driver usually held at gunpoint -- and dubbed the "crime capital of the world". Local residents hailed the man's actions as a victory for victims of the city's crime wave.
"Crack out the champagne. If they had got caught and got bail they would have been out again straight away," said a caller to a local talk radio station.
Many South Africans say that the country's criminal justice system has broken down and that police are slow to respond to emergency calls.
